# Commands

Everything the window can be told to do, by title as the command bar shows it: 87. Open the bar with **`Ctrl+k` / `⌘k`** and type part of a title. The id is what `keybindings.json` names to put a command on a key.

The window adds more while it runs, which this list cannot show: a toggle for each panel, including a plugin's, an entry for each recently opened file, and one for each export preset of the open folder, `export.preset:<name>`.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Undo | `editor.undo` | `Ctrl+z` | `⌘z` |
| Redo | `editor.redo` | `Ctrl+y`, `Ctrl+Shift+z` | `⌘⇧z`, `Ctrl⇧z` |
| Find | `editor.find` | `Ctrl+f` | `⌘f` |
| Find: next | `editor.findNext` | `Ctrl+g` | `⌘g` |
| Find: previous | `editor.findPrevious` | `Ctrl+Shift+g` | `⌘⇧g` |
| Replace: next match | `editor.replaceNext` |  |  |
